record.title: Cyprus: three RoC crossing suspensions with June 2020 reopening
record.scope: RoC side of three Green Line crossing points; de facto divide, not an internationally recognised interstate border
record.direction: Crossing through the RoC-controlled posts in either direction
record.movement: Ordinary persons crossing the three specified posts
record.exceptions: June reopening limited to eligible citizens/residents and special categories with health conditions.
record.enforcement: EC retrospective reports reopening; contemporary Reuters extract reports reopening beginning, without separately observing each of the three gates.
record.relationship: Related to GS001, but different crossing/authority and endpoint; do not count as an independent national policy.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; no inference about present status
record.official_rationale: RoC authorities presented the suspensions as COVID-19 precautions.
record.context: This phase excludes Ledra Street, whose suspension lasted longer. The two sides did not necessarily admit identical categories.
record.uncertainty: Gate-specific dates depend on an indexed official report; full-page retrieval blocked. Endpoint is the RoC-side conditional reopening, not unrestricted passage across both authorities.

historical.duration_note: Calendar-date difference to the stated partial reopening for the specified category and crossing; not exact hours or universal closure
